description:
SimpleLPR is a professional-grade license plate recognition
        (LPR/ANPR) library with support for 90+ countries, real-time video
        processing, multi-threaded analysis and intelligent plate tracking.
        This artifact is the Java binding (Java 11+, Windows x64 and Linux
        x64). To run without an installed SimpleLPR SDK, also add the natives
        artifact for your platform: classifier natives-win-x64 or
        natives-linux-x64. 60-day evaluation included; commercial licensing at
        https://www.warelogic.com.
